contexts.text: (These animals) = divers cupidities and badnesses.
The more malice there is in the hatreds, the more profanity there is in the worship.
The badness and infidelity of an evil Spirit (are known from every word he utters).
I perceived... what wickedness there was in the deceit.

In this Hell are the most malicious... They pour out the poison of their malice to those who are in the World of Spirits... They are interiorly malicious... They are veiled as with a cloud, which is the sphere of their malice... SE 4553.
These also are malicious; but not to that degree.
These are most malicious. AC 5721:2, Described. SE 4587.
Malice, cunning, and deceit, are signified by... those serpents which are poisonous.
(The infernals) use all malice, cunning, and cruelty...
Malice to deprive the neighbour of eternal life. Signified, Explained.
(The evils of wickedness. Enumerated.)
[Swedenborg footnote 2.]. That sensuous men are cunning and malicious above all others. References.
They who have been interiorly wicked, and exteriorly good in appearance...
These, under civil pretences, have dealt wickedly with the neighbour.
On the wickedness and nefarious arts of infernal Spirits, Chapter. HH 580.
In the degree in which there are wisdom and intelligence with the Angels there are wickedness and cunning with infernal Spirits.
The wickedness of those who are called Genii. Described.
(These) are not so wicked.
Believes wickedness to be wisdom... DP 298.
Instead of thoughts of wickedness there are implanted thoughts of wisdom.
Malicious desertion...
Iniquity and wickedness would spread through the whole Christian world.
In place of goods there succeeds wickedness.
On the wickedness of certain Spirits. Described.
When wickedness comes to its height, they precipitate themselves into penalties...
Thus their wickedness is at last consummated...
The Swedes are one of the bad nations.
On account of the wickedness of those who dwell in it ().
The king they make glad through their wickedness () = all falsity from evil.
Wisdom is of truth from good, whereas wickedness is of falsity from evil.
For all wickedness resides in evil, and all intelligence in good.
But cunning and wickedness are not prudence and intelligence...
Evil hides in itself all cunning and wickedness, as good does all prudence and wisdom.
Wash thy heart from wickedness ()... Wickedness is attributed to the heart, because the heart corresponds to the will, in which wickedness resides.
To persist in evils and falsities of doctrine is signified by a man's not returning from his wickedness ().
Wickedness = evil; iniquity, falsities.
Wickedness excels in a sensuous man in the same proportion as intelligence in a spiritual man.
The seed of the wicked () = direful falsity of evil.
